name: RMN-Player
changelog: Fix: High-DPI Typography & Font Clarity on Linux — bundled official Vazirmatn font family (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold) directly in player fonts, configured crisp sub-hinting, native display subtitle rendering (blend-subtitles=no), optimized border and shadow contrast, and set Vazirmatn as the default UI & subtitle font across Linux and Windows.
